integrity: Analytic proof with independently executable finite floating-point formula checks; no claim of independent validation or certification.
scientific_limitations: The sharp formulas do not cover transmission-proportional noise that disappears under full transmission suppression, finite-state epidemic counts, budgeted treatment, or a numerical scheme specific to another diffusion. Random initial infection distributions satisfy a weighted risk lower bound without universal exact attainment. Broad unidentified control literature and an inaccessible finite-state comparison paper remain originality risks.
scientific_scope: Two-compartment controlled stochastic susceptible-infected model with strictly positive initial compartments, Itô infected-only noise of constant per-capita intensity independent of controls, bounded nonnegative progressively measurable interventions and the admissibility of full incidence suppression. Exact simultaneous terminal, finite and infinite-horizon infection threshold probabilities; total-variation support consequence.
title: Sharp infection-peak risk under bounded intervention with persistent multiplicative noise
